one_line: Class project pre-joining ~4 years of Inside Airbnb scrapes for 10 US cities (~347k listing rows, SQLite) to Zillow ZHVI/ZRI housing indices.
abnb_use: Directly touches gap #13 (STR vs. long-term-rental crossover, host supply economics) with a ready multi-city, multi-year join already built.
sample_plan: Pull the committed SQLite database (or data/database_sample.txt) and the two small Zillow CSVs (ZHVI 507 rows, ZRI 466 rows); NYC/LA raw listings were excluded from the repo so nothing oversized to worry about.
